headline: Capital Clean Energy Q3 Earnings and Revenue Beat Estimates
summary: Capital Clean Energy reported third-quarter earnings that beat analyst expectations by $0.07 alongside revenue that topped estimates.
why: Positive quarterly earnings surprises validate operational execution and can drive upward revisions to equity valuations in the clean energy sector.

impacts.name: Capital Clean Energy Carriers Corp
impacts.why: Earnings and revenue beating consensus estimates increases investor demand for the stock.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Better-than-expected financial results directly prompted positive trading interest following the earnings release.
